book.name: FILIPENSES
book.title: FILIPENSES Filipos macãrãre Pablo cʉ̃ ca queti owa cojorica pũuro

content: Añuro niiricaro ca tiirije

Apeyera ñucã yʉ yaarã yʉ ca mairã, Jesucristo mena ʉjea niiña. Yʉra, mʉjare yʉ ca owa cojoriquepʉrena yʉ ca owa cojo nemocã tua waarucujata, bojoricaro bii pato wãcõrucu biiti, mʉja peera añurije maquẽ ca niiro macã.

Ĩa biijejaya manirije ca tiirãre, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yee quetire ca wederã nii pacarã ñañarije ca tiirãre, “Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yaarã mani nii,” ĩirã, cʉ̃ja jeyua quejerorire ca wide weo baterã menare, bojoca catiri niiña.

Mania, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yʉʉ Añuri Yeri jʉori cʉ̃re ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉorã, Cristo Jesús yaarã niiri ca ʉjea niirã nii, bojoca cʉ̃ja majuropeera ñañarije manirã niirʉgarã, cʉ̃ja ca tii niirijere tʉo nʉnʉjeeti, ca biirã pee mani nii, jeyua quejero yapare wide taaricarã majurope ca niirã.
Yʉ majuropeera, atera, “Díámacʉ̃ra niiro bii,” ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉogʉ peti niigʉ yʉ bii. Jĩcʉ̃ ʉno atere, “Díámacʉ̃ ca niirijera niiro bii,” cʉ̃ ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉojata:

Yʉ ca baʉaro jiro jĩcã amo peti, ape amore itiaga penituaro ca niiri rʉmʉre yʉ jeyua quejero yapare cʉ̃ja ca wide taaricʉ, israelita bojocʉ, Benjamín yaa puna macʉ̃, hebreo bojocʉ, ñucã hebreo macʉ̃, judíos, doti cũuriquere, “O biro ĩirʉgaro ĩi” cʉ̃ja ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉorije peera fariseos yaa pooga macʉ̃, yʉ niiwʉ.

Ñucã doti cũurique ca ĩirijere ametʉene nʉcãriquere ca bootigʉ yʉ ca niirique peera, Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerãre ñañaro cʉ̃jare ca tiirʉga nʉnʉjeericʉ, doti cũurique peera jĩcã wãme dʉjaricaro maniro ca tii nʉnʉjeegʉ ca niiricʉ pee doca, cʉ̃ ametʉenero, “Díámacʉ̃ ca niirijera niiro bii,” ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉoricʉ peti niigʉ yʉ bii yʉ doca.
Ate niipetirije jʉgueropʉre yʉra, ca nii majuropeerije ca niimirique, mecʉ̃ra Jesucristo jʉori ca wapa manirije niiro bii yua.

O biro bii ñucã: Yʉ Wiogʉ Cristo Jesús cʉ̃ ca añu ametʉene majuropeerijere yʉ ca majirije mena, atere yʉ ca ĩa cõoñajata, jĩcã wãme ʉno peerena, “Ca nii majuropeerije nii,” yʉ ĩiti majuropeecã. Cristo jʉori tee niipetirijepʉra ca wapa manirijere biro tuacãwʉ. Mecʉ̃ra yua Cristo peere bʉa eari: “Ca bii bateriquepʉ nii,”
yʉ ĩicã.

Cʉ̃ mena pee niirʉgama ĩigʉ, yʉ majuropeera doti cũurique ca ĩirore biro yʉ ca tii nʉnʉjeerije jʉori, ñañarije manigʉ niiriquere yʉ amaati. Jesucristore díámacʉ̃ tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorique jʉori pee Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, ca ñañarije manigʉ yʉ ca niiro cʉ̃ ca tiirije peere yʉ ama.

Cristo cʉ̃ ca cati tuarique ca tutua majuropeerijere yʉ majuropeera biiñacã, ñañaro cʉ̃ ca tamʉoricarore birora tamʉo, cʉ̃ ca bii yairicarore birora bii yai, biirʉgama ĩigʉ, niipetirijepʉrena ca wapa manirijere biro yʉ ĩacãwʉ.
To biri yʉ cãa, ca bii yairicarã cʉ̃ja ca cati tuari rʉmʉre yʉ ca cati tuapere yʉ yue.
Ʉmʉreco tutipʉ ca niiparã

Mee niipetirije bʉa ea peoticã, ñucã “Ca ñañarije manigʉpʉ yʉ nii,” ĩigʉ méé yʉ ĩi. Teere ca bʉa eapʉ cʉ̃ niijato ĩigʉ Cristo Jesús cʉ̃ ca jʉoricʉ yʉ ca niirijere, cʉ̃ pee yʉre cʉ̃ ca maji jʉoricarore birora teere bʉa earʉgʉ, cʉ̃ yeere to birora yʉ tiicã nʉnʉa waa.

Yʉ yaarã, “Mee yʉ majuropeera teere yʉ bʉa eacãwʉ,” yʉ ĩi tʉgoeñati. Ate pee docare o biro yʉ tii. Jʉgueropʉ yʉ ca biirique cʉti niiriquere acobo, jiropʉ yʉ ca bʉa eape peere tʉgoeñari, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca boorije peere bʉaro jañuro yʉ tii nʉnʉa waa.
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, Cristo jʉori añurijere ʉmʉreco tutipʉ manire cʉ̃ ca tiicojopere yʉ ca ñeepere biro ĩigʉ, añurije peere tii yapano earʉgʉ yʉ tii.

To biri mani niipetirã, añuropʉ díámacʉ̃ ca tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉo bayicoarãpʉa, ano mʉjare yʉ ca ĩirore biro wado ca tʉgoeñaparã mani nii. Ñucã jĩcã wãme ʉnore bojoricaro mʉja ca tʉgoeñajata, tee cãare mʉja ca majiro mʉjare tiirucumi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ.
Tee docare, jĩcã wãmera tii nʉnʉjee, jĩcʉ̃ peere biro tʉgoeña, biiriquere mani ca bʉa earique ca niirore biro ca tii nʉnʉjeeparã mani nii.
Yʉ yaarã, niipetirã yʉre biro bii nʉnʉjeeya. Mʉjare jãa ca bii ĩñoricarore biro ca bii niirã cãare ĩa cõoña.
Mee, paʉ tiiri mʉjare yʉ ĩiwʉ. Ñucã mecʉ̃ cãare teerena, yacó cape cʉtiri mʉjare yʉ ĩi nemo. Paʉ niicãma, Jesucristo yucʉ tenipʉ cʉ̃ ca bii yairiquere ca junarãre biro ca tii niirã.

Biirãpʉa cʉ̃ja, ñañaro ca bii yaiparã niirã biima. Cʉ̃ja upʉri ca boorore biro wado cʉ̃ja ca tii niirijera nii, cʉ̃ja ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉo niirije. To biro cʉ̃ja ca tii niirijere bobo tʉgoeñaricaro ʉno, “O biro ca biirã jãa nii,” ĩi docuorucuma. Ñucã ati yepa maquẽ pee wadore bʉaro amama tee cãare.
Mani pea ʉmʉreco tuti macã yepa macãrãpʉ mani nii. Manire Ca Ametʉenegʉ, Wiogʉ Jesucristo cãare toopʉ ca niigʉ ca doopʉrena mani yue nii.
Cʉ̃a mani upʉ ca añutiri upʉre, cʉ̃ upʉ ca añuri upʉre biro pee manire wajoarucumi. Niipetirijere cʉ̃ ca doti tutuarije mena to biro manire tiirucumi Jesucristo.
